correctness.rationale: Direct subtraction yields s constant, xdot=-2 sin(s) sin(y), ydot=2 sin(s) sin(x). Each nonzero |h|<2 level is a single compact regular oval; quarter-period quadrature gives 4K(k)/|2 sin s|. The involution (x,y)->(y,x) reverses flow and makes cos x-cos y odd, establishing zero common-phase holonomy; contractibility excludes phase-difference winding. Elliptic K limits give pi/|sin s| and (2/|sin s|)log(8/|h|). Frozen leaves and saddles are relative equilibria; separatrices are heteroclinic. The theorem is confined to four equal coupled phases at quadrature.
